experiments.title: Confirm fragmented OHSE workflow pain
experiments.assumption: Multi-site OHSE teams lose material time and control because risks, evidence and actions are fragmented across paper, email and spreadsheets.
experiments.passThreshold: At least 12 of 15 relevant interviews confirm material recurring pain and at least 3 workflows are observed or reconstructed.
experiments.decisionOnPass: Advance problem validation and prototype the evidence-to-action loop.
experiments.decisionOnFail: Narrow the target segment or stop the thesis.

experiments.title: Validate the smallest valuable workflow
experiments.assumption: Users value a controlled risk-action-evidence-closure loop more than a broad static document repository.
experiments.passThreshold: At least 80% of representative users complete five critical prototype tasks and prefer the operational loop.
experiments.decisionOnPass: Freeze the MVP boundary around the validated loop.

experiments.title: Secure a formal pilot commitment
experiments.assumption: A target organization will commit named users, operating access and a commercial or equivalent formal pilot authorization.
experiments.passThreshold: Signed pilot, purchase commitment, deposit or formally authorized controlled deployment.
experiments.decisionOnPass: Build and release the minimum reliable pilot.
experiments.decisionOnFail: Hold development and revisit buyer, segment or offer.

risks.description: EL-VECTOR scope expands before the critical workflow is validated.
risks.control: MVP exclusion list, change gate and sponsor approval for scope additions.

risks.description: Pilot users show interest but the budget owner does not commit.
risks.control: Separate user, sponsor, buyer and procurement discovery; require behavioural commitment before build.

risks.description: Pilot data or evidence is exposed through weak tenant or access controls.
risks.control: Least privilege, tenant isolation test, access review, secure evidence storage and incident process.

decisions.decision: Limit protected leadership priorities to the core operating platform, cash-engine standardization and EL-VECTOR pilot.
decisions.rationale: Concentrate scarce capacity and prevent simultaneous full builds across strategic options.
